description_en: Retrieves a list of normalization fields
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-fields --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --name category --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --normalization-field-source native --normalization-schema-type log --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationFields

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:

en: English
